_comment: iOS-only strings with no counterpart in the web app's translation
dictionary - mostly VoiceOver labels and platform-specific wording
that has no web equivalent to borrow.
'strings' is the English source of truth (development language).
'translations' holds the professionally-translated value for each
of the other 24 ZRP languages, keyed by language code then by the
same key. generate-localizations.py emits each language's own
entries into that language's .lproj; a key genuinely absent for a
language falls back to the development language exactly as any
other missing key does (see L10n.swift), never a raw key.
which fails if any of these 160 keys is missing a translation for
any of the 24 non-English languages, or if a translation carries
placeholders that don't match the English source exactly.
